num_trips: <int> Total number of timed bus trips to be covered across all lines and directions.
num_depots: <int> Number of vehicle depots available in the transit network.
num_lines: <int> Number of bus lines operated in the network.
trips_per_line_per_direction: <int> Number of trips scheduled per line per direction over the planning horizon.
speed_type: <str> Speed profile category that determines which set of time-of-day operational speeds applies.
coordinate_area_km: <list[int], length 2> Width and height in kilometers of the rectangular area in which all locations are placed.

locations.{location_name}: <list[int], length 2> X and Y coordinates in kilometers of the named location (depot or line endpoint).

depots.name: <str> Name of this depot matching its key in the locations dictionary.
depots.coordinates: <list[int], length 2> X and Y coordinates in kilometers of this depot.

relief_locations: <list[str], length num_lines+1 or num_lines> Names of locations where driver changeovers may take place.

lines.from: <str> Name of the origin endpoint of this bus line.
lines.to: <str> Name of the destination endpoint of this bus line.

trips.trip_id: <int> Zero-based index identifying this trip, ordered by departure time.
trips.start_time: <int> Departure time of this trip in minutes from midnight.
trips.end_time: <int> Arrival time of this trip in minutes from midnight.
trips.start_location: <str> Name of the origin location where this trip departs.
trips.end_location: <str> Name of the destination location where this trip arrives.

{origin}.{destination}: <int> Deadhead travel time in minutes from origin to destination.
<float> Euclidean distance in kilometers from origin to destination.

deadhead_speed_km_per_hour: <int> Speed in kilometers per hour at which vehicles travel empty between assignments.

operational_speeds_km_per_hour.{time_interval}: <int> In-service vehicle speed in kilometers per hour during this time-of-day interval.

frequency_table_minutes.{time_interval}: <int> Minutes between consecutive departures on the same line and direction during this time-of-day interval.

{duty_type_name}.type_id: <int> Numeric identifier for this duty type.
{duty_type_name}.num_pieces: <int> Number of consecutive work segments that compose a duty of this type.
{duty_type_name}.piece_length_min: <int> Minimum allowed duration in minutes of each work segment.
{duty_type_name}.piece_length_max: <int> Maximum allowed duration in minutes of each work segment.
{duty_type_name}.break_length_min: <int or null> Minimum required break duration in minutes between work segments, or null if no break applies.
{duty_type_name}.duty_length_max: <int or null> Maximum total span in minutes from sign-on to sign-off, or null if unconstrained.
{duty_type_name}.work_time_max: <int or null> Maximum cumulative working time in minutes within the duty, or null if unconstrained.
{duty_type_name}.start_time_min: <int or null> Earliest allowed duty start time in minutes from midnight, or null if unconstrained.
{duty_type_name}.start_time_max: <int or null> Latest allowed duty start time in minutes from midnight, or null if unconstrained.
{duty_type_name}.end_time_max: <int or null> Latest allowed duty end time in minutes from midnight, or null if unconstrained.

crew_parameters.sign_on_time_depot_minutes: <int> Time in minutes added to duty duration when a driver signs on at a depot.
crew_parameters.sign_off_time_depot_minutes: <int> Time in minutes added to duty duration when a driver signs off at a depot.
crew_parameters.extra_time_non_depot_relief_minutes: <int> Extra time in minutes added when a driver starts or ends at a non-depot relief location.
crew_parameters.extra_time_includes_deadhead_to_depot: <bool> Whether the extra time for non-depot relief includes the deadhead travel time to the depot.
crew_parameters.max_pieces_per_duty: <int> Maximum number of consecutive work segments allowed in any single duty.
crew_parameters.continuous_attendance: <bool> Whether a driver must remain on the vehicle whenever it is outside the depot.
crew_parameters.changeovers_allowed: <bool> Whether a driver may transfer to a different vehicle during a break between work segments.

vehicle_parameters.each_vehicle_has_own_depot: <bool> Whether each vehicle operates from and returns to a single home depot.
vehicle_parameters.unlimited_vehicles_per_depot: <bool> Whether the fleet size at each depot is unlimited.
vehicle_parameters.all_depots_can_serve_all_trips: <bool> Whether every depot may serve every trip regardless of line.
vehicle_parameters.fictitious_cost_per_minute_empty_outside: <int> Cost rate per minute charged when a vehicle sits idle outside its home depot.
